realization_scope: the particular large class of nonlocal form factors studied by Zhao, Modesto and Bambi, arXiv:2605.01413 / EPJC 86 (2026) 713
observable: existence of exact vacuum Godel-type solutions with closed timelike curves
interpretation: This realization class admits exact vacuum geometries with closed timelike curves. Renormalizability alone is therefore not a family-wide causality certificate. The result is not promoted to the full NONLOCAL_QG family because form-factor/background dependence remains material.
authority: Zhao, Modesto, Bambi, Eur. Phys. J. C 86, 713 (2026), arXiv:2605.01413
